audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that this page never names a single Irelia ability, and all seven phase reasons are shared template text that calls her 'he'.
audit.why: The stages turn on Bladesurge's resets, Flawless Duet's 16s stun and Defiant Dance — none of which appear anywhere in the full layer.
audit.corrected: Every phase reason rewritten naming Bladesurge, Defiant Dance, Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge, in second person.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said only 'her ultimate changes the math too', and the item stages gave no reason at all.
audit.why: Vanguard's Edge is 125s at rank 1 and leaves a wall that damages and slows anyone crossing it — at 6 it is a zoning tool, not burst. Irelia's real scaling is Ionian Fervor stacks plus attack speed items, which is why she takes the late duel.
audit.corrected: phases[4] names Vanguard's Edge and its wall; phases[6] states she wins the long fight, matching the 47.44% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. Defiant Dance reduces physical damage only, so it does nothing against your kit — and Bladesurge is targeted, so Twilight Shroud denies it.
audit.why: Riot's descriptions: Defiant Dance — 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge'; Bladesurge — 'Irelia dashes forward to strike her target', refreshing when the target is Marked or dies. Akali's damage is magic, and Twilight Shroud makes her unable to be selected.
audit.corrected: The physical-only reduction is stated in phases[2].why and dosFull[1].d; the targeted-dash denial in phases[1].why, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t.

audit.why: Flawless Duet 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Bladesurge 10s at rank 1 and it refreshes off Marked targets and kills, Defiant Dance 20s, Vanguard's Edge 125s at rank 1; your W is 20s and E 16s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Let her reset off minions' was described as diving with no shroud and no energy.
audit.why: Shared template copy with the wrong pronoun.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title, naming the Bladesurge reset condition.

edits.before: Shroud her dash — deny resets, Q-poke her. Akali wins the Flawless Duet cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shroud her Bladesurge — deny resets, keep waves small. Akali wins the Flawless Duet windows.

edits.before: Shroud her dash and deny resets. Track Flawless Duet before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud her dash and deny resets. Flawless Duet is 16s at rank 1 — commit only inside that gap.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Irelia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Bladesurge lets her reach any last hit and heal off it. Farm at Q tip and keep the wave small so she has no resets.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Irelia's Flawless Duet is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites her trade: Bladesurge is targeted, so from smoke her dash finds nothing.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Irelia must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, and Defiant Dance only cuts physical damage — your kit is magic, so your burst lands in full.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Flawless Duet's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Flawless Duet is 16s at rank 1 and marks what it stuns, which refreshes her Bladesurge — dodge the converge.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Irelia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Vanguard's Edge (125s) leaves a wall that damages and slows — never take your exit through it.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Flawless Duet's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight while her Flawless Duet is still on its 16s.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Irelia carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on but she out-duels you late: Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed, so pick her, never brawl her side lane.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Flawless Duet (16s at rank 1): the stun that starts everything, and it Marks you for a Bladesurge reset. - Bladesurge (10s): targeted, so smoke denies it, and it refreshes on Marks and kills. - Defiant Dance: physical only.

edits.before: Q Irelia at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q her at 550, E-mark and dash in once Flawless Duet is spent, then Shroud her Bladesurge answer.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Fighting inside a big wave — every minion she kills with Bladesurge refreshes the dash.

edits.before: Q Irelia at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Defiant Dance only reduces physical damage, so her charge does nothing about your magic burst.

edits.before: Irelia wastes Flawless Duet (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: It refreshes on Marked targets and on kills — keep the wave small.

edits.before: That is Irelia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The converge Marks you, and that Mark refreshes her Bladesurge straight onto you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Every minion she Bladesurges through refreshes that dash again.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: A Marked target or a kill refreshes Bladesurge outright, so deny her both of those things.

edits.before: Track Irelia's Flawless Duet (Stun): Her engage CC. Shroud-dodge it. When it is down — E-Q + R her.
edits.after: Bladesurge is targeted, so smoke denies it. Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only, never your magic.

notes: This matchup is Akali-unfavoured at 47.44% over 1437 games, and the full layer's phases already give levels 3 onward to Akali. I did not change any stage owner because the champion-name enum cannot be swapped inside the applier's +/-10% length band, but phases[6] in particular reads as an Akali stage while the win rate and Ionian Fervor scaling both say otherwise — flagging it for a hand pass. suspectNames flagged 'Drop Twilight Shroud' in wants.you[1]: false positive.
